slides.title: Get started
slides.html:
'Twin detectives': once two triangles are proven twins, what else must match? Pairs list every consequence from one marked diagram.

  • I can use CPCTC to get a side or angle only after the triangles are proved congruent.
  • I can solve for a variable from a corresponding-part equation and check it.

geo.title: Get started
geo.body:
'Twin detectives': once two triangles are proven twins, what else must match? Pairs list every consequence from one marked diagram.

  • I can use CPCTC to get a side or angle only after the triangles are proved congruent.
  • I can solve for a variable from a corresponding-part equation and check it.

slides.title: The big idea
slides.html: CPCTC is a consequence, never a test. It always sits below the congruence line.

geo.title: The big idea
geo.body: CPCTC is a consequence, never a test. It always sits below the congruence line.

slides.title: Worked example
slides.html:
Two equations from one congruence (original).

Read the worked steps
StepReason
Triangle ABC ≅ triangle DEF, BC = 4x - 3, EF = 13, angle A = (2y + 5) degrees, angle D = 35 degrees.Given.
BC = EF, so 4x - 3 = 13 and x = 4.CPCTC, then solve.
Angle A = angle D, so 2y + 5 = 35 and y = 15.CPCTC, then solve.
So BC = 13 and angle A = 35 degrees.Substitute back.

steps.step: Triangle ABC ≅ triangle DEF, BC = 4x - 3, EF = 13, angle A = (2y + 5) degrees, angle D = 35 degrees.
Angle A = angle D, so 2y + 5 = 35 and y = 15.
So BC = 13 and angle A = 35 degrees.

slides.title: Common mistake
slides.html:
Jordan uses CPCTC before proving congruence.

Try it on paper first, then reveal.

Find and fix the error

CPCTC can't come before the line that proves the triangles congruent. Move it below.

slides.title: Practice 1
slides.html:
In Worked example 1, which side matches AD?

Try it on paper first, then reveal.

Reveal solution

CD, because A matches C and D matches D.

Reveal second check

Read ABD and CBD letter by letter.

slides.title: Practice 2
slides.html:
Triangle ABC ≅ triangle RST and AC = 8. Find RT.

Try it on paper first, then reveal.

Reveal solution

RT = 8 by CPCTC.

Reveal second check

1st and 3rd letters match 1st and 3rd letters.

geo.title: Practice 2

slides.title: Practice 3
slides.html:
Triangle ABC ≅ triangle DEF, AB = 5x + 2 and DE = 22. Find x.

Try it on paper first, then reveal.

Reveal solution

5x + 2 = 22, so 5x = 20 and x = 4.

Reveal second check

Plug in: 5(4) + 2 = 22.

slides.title: Check yourself
slides.html:
Can you use CPCTC to prove the two triangles are congruent?

Try it on paper first, then reveal.

Reveal solution

No. CPCTC comes after congruence is proved; it cannot be used to prove it.

Reveal second check

Name the givens and the theorem or definition used.
